questions.q: Can we move our call to next week? My ___ is huge at the moment.
questions.explainRo: **Workload** înseamnă volum de muncă: ai foarte multă treabă în perioada asta.

questions.q: My new flatmate is really ___: nothing stresses her, and she's always calm.
questions.explainRo: **Easy-going** descrie o persoană relaxată și calmă; outgoing înseamnă sociabil.

questions.q: Our neighbour ___ three old cars, but he never drives them.
questions.explainRo: **Own** este verb de stare (posesie), deci nu are formă continuă; la he adăugăm -s: owns.

questions.q: Can I call you back in an hour? I ___ lunch with a client right now.
questions.explainRo: Aici **have** înseamnă „a lua masa” (acțiune), deci poate sta la present continuous: I am having lunch now.

questions.q: A: ___ B: I'm a nurse. I work at a children's hospital.
questions.explainRo: „Cu ce te ocupi?” se spune **What do you do?** (present simple, despre meserie).

questions.audio: My parents are currently travelling in Portugal.
answers: My parents are currently travelling in Portugal.
My parents are currently traveling in Portugal.
questions.ro: Părinții mei călătoresc acum prin Portugalia.
questions.explainRo: **Currently** + present continuous arată o situație temporară, din perioada aceasta.

questions.q: My dad ___ (fix) everything in the house himself — he never calls anyone.
answers: fixes
questions.explainRo: Este un obicei, deci present simple; la he, după -x adăugăm **-es**: fixes.

questions.q: A technician is ___ (set) up our new Wi-Fi router right now.
answers: setting
questions.explainRo: **Set up** = a configura; acțiunea se întâmplă acum, deci is setting up (t se dublează).

questions.q: Thanks, but I ___ (not / need) any help at the moment — the update is almost finished.
answers: don't need
do not need
questions.explainRo: **Need** este verb de stare și rămâne la present simple chiar și cu „at the moment”.
Ceva temporar, valabil doar azi: present continuous, cu are înaintea subiectului în întrebare.

questions.ro: Ce părere ai despre noul logo?
questions.explainRo: Când **think** înseamnă „a crede, a avea o părere”, este verb de stare: What do you think…?

questions.ro: De obicei beau ceai, dar azi beau cafea.
answers: I usually drink tea, but today I'm drinking coffee.
I usually drink tea, but today I am drinking coffee.

Usually I drink tea, but today I am drinking coffee.
Usually I drink tea, but I'm drinking coffee today.
Usually I drink tea, but I am drinking coffee today.
I normally drink tea, but today I'm drinking coffee.
I normally drink tea, but today I am drinking coffee.
I normally drink tea, but I'm drinking coffee today.
I normally drink tea, but I am drinking coffee today.
I usually have tea, but today I'm having coffee.
I usually have tea, but today I am having coffee.
I usually have tea, but I'm having coffee today.
I usually have tea, but I am having coffee today.
questions.explainRo: Obiceiul (usually) cere present simple, iar excepția de azi cere present continuous.
